changelog: 5.9.27 (Build 5927): App Updates now check a live update file (app-updates.json) in the RubyOS update repo, so new app updates can be published without a whole new RubyOS release. The Store checks that file, shows waiting updates with an Update button, and required updates stop the app from opening until it is updated. Updating takes 30 seconds with a percentage, then the app checks its functions work. First live update: Ruby Notes 1.2 (required) adds a Copy button by the word counter.
Ruby AI stays off until its API key is ready. Everything else is unchanged.
